about_the_game:
🔥 Sinister Outbreak – You woke up in a nightmare. Now fight your way out.

You wake up in a dark, deserted laboratory... and it's far too quiet. There's no memory of what happened — just blood on the walls and the sound of something approaching. Something that is no longer alive.
Welcome to Sinister Outbreak, an action-packed game set in a chilling atmosphere of horror and survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.

short_description: Sinister Outbreak is an action-horror game where you wake up in a zombie-infested lab. With no memory and danger around every corner, fight to survive, uncover the truth, and escape the nightmare.
